identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-09][provider] Add Kimi and current agentic model providers

values.task_boundary: Build an execution-ready preparation packet for #5526 and stop before product implementation.
deliverables: Future provider/model validation plan and review focus
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: every provider retains a distinct vendor identity even when using a shared wire protocol
AC-2: provider secrets are read only from approved sources and never emitted to stdout, logs, cards, traces, fixtures, or retained artifacts
AC-3: model aliases cannot silently change retained execution identity; resolved provider/model/version truth is recorded
AC-4: model discovery is bounded, cached or snapshotted, timeout-controlled, and not required for deterministic replay
AC-5: tool-call, JSON, reasoning, multimodal, context-window, streaming, and caching capabilities are evidence-backed per model
AC-6: authentication, quota, unsupported-feature, malformed-response, timeout, cancellation, and provider-unavailable paths are classified consistently
AC-7: direct-provider proof is distinct from OpenRouter proof and local Ollama/vLLM profiles remain distinct from hosted vendors
AC-8: provider matrix feeds scheduler/model-role selection without granting lifecycle authority
AC-9: focused tests and one bounded pre-PR review pass before publication
dependencies: Parent WP-09 provider/governed-tool adapter issue #5349 live-merged and ancestral on current origin/main
non_goals: No separate transport stack for every OpenAI-compatible provider
No production-readiness claim from one completion
No autonomous workflow authority from a model or benchmark
No credential requirement for deterministic adapter closure when live proof is separately gated
